subject: Re: Discovery follow-up — cost constraints & pilot path
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel@crestpay.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@crestpay.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick follow from today's discovery

Thanks for the call this morning, Tessa — good overview. Two quick things I promised to pull together: a short list of our primary constraints and an expectation for a 30/60 day proof. High level notes from our side: 
- Monthly budget for LLM infra starts at ~$15k/mo, may expand if we see clear ROI by Q2.
- Most volume is low-latency chat (avg session ~120 tokens outgoing, 600 tokens incoming); peak concurrency during batch ops at EOD.
- Security: SOC 2 evidence and audit logs required for procurement sign-off.
- Value metrics: 20% reduction in manual review time & 10% increase in conversion for guided flows would justify expansion.

Can you send a simple cost model and two pilot options (conservative + aggressive) that show expected spend and where batching/caching save us money? Also need an estimated timeline for SOC2 evidence collection.

Thanks,
Daniel
Director of Product
CrestPay
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel@crestpay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 14:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick follow from today's discovery — draft cost options attached

Hi Daniel — thanks again for the time. Short recap and concrete next steps below so we stay aligned.

Recap of pain & goals (as I heard them):
- Budget ceiling ~ $15k/mo to start; must show clear ROI for expansion.
- Primary workload: chat-like flows with occasional high-throughput batch jobs at end-of-day.
- Compliance: SOC 2 + audit log export is gating procurement.
- Success signals: automation savings and conversion lift tied to feature rollouts.

How Redwood helps (quick):
- Token economics: streaming + KV prefix caching reduces repeated prompt cost; batching for EOD jobs will materially cut per-token unit cost.
- Deployment options: start hosted API, switch to Dedicated reserved pool for predictable throughput if commit makes sense.
- Controls: per-route SLOs, trace-level cost breakdown, and audit logs for SOC evidence collection.

Attachments I've included: crestpay_cost_model_v1.xlsx (simple 3-scenario cost model: baseline, batching-enabled, and committed-dedicated).

Proposed next steps (pick one):
1) Conservative pilot (30 days, no commit): Hosted API, sample set of 25k monthly sessions; objective — validate latency and conversion lift. Estimated starting spend: $9k–$13k based on current volumes, see attached.
2) Aggressive pilot (60 days, optional reserved burst): 60-day pilot with dedicated GPU burst hours for peak processing + prefix cache enabled. Estimated spend window: $12k–$18k; shows how batching reduces per-token spend by ~35% in our model.

Operational asks from CrestPay: procurement will need SOC 2 artifact checklist and one-week window for log exports. We can provide the SOC 2 summary and a sample audit log export within 3 business days for review.

Please confirm which pilot you prefer and whether procurement wants the SOW draft; I can circulate a 1-page SOW + PO template once you say go.

Cheers,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
--
Tessa Morgan
Redwood Inference
email: tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com
phone: +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Draft cost options for CrestPay — negotiation and ops notes

Looping in a couple quick negotiation and implementation suggestions based on the model Tessa attached: 
- Offer a 30-day pilot with hard usage cap (e.g., $15k spend cap) and an optional 30-day extension at a pre-agreed discount — keeps procurement comfortable.
- On pricing: structure as hosted list rate, then present a committed discount schedule if they move to Dedicated (1–3 month commit bands).
- Technical ops: propose we enable prefix caching + conservative batching on the pilot to hit the lower-bound spend scenario; that will give them demonstrable per-token savings quickly.
- Compliance: Marissa, can you confirm we have the SOC 2 artifact package and a recommended log export script we can hand them? If yes, I’ll draft the one-page SOW and attach the cost workbook.

Thanks — happy to revise numbers after procurement feedback.
Ben
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Daniel Park <daniel@crestpay.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@crestpay.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick follow from today's discovery — decision on pilot path

Thanks, Tessa — appreciate the clear options and the workbook. We reviewed the conservative and aggressive scenarios with our product + procurement. Procurement asked that we start with the conservative 30-day pilot but with two requirements: 
1) A hard $15k spend cap on the pilot (must not exceed without explicit PO amendment).
2) Receipt of SOC 2 artifact checklist + sample log export before procurement signs.

If you can send the 1-page SOW and the SOC 2 artifacts + the cost workbook in PDF, we can route internally this week. Also attaching a short Procurement intake form (attached).

On the pilot timing: targeting pilot start 2026-12-01 if we can get the SOW and artifacts over by Monday.

Appreciate it — looking forward to getting this moving.
Daniel
Director of Product
CrestPay
Attachments: Procurement_intake_form.pdf
